commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Ship the review command, string hunk refs, and diff reading aids since 0.8.0.

CLI
- New `review` command writes a covering skeleton: one path per changed file in group `ungrouped`, stub prose. It resolves the base and head once and parses the diff once.
- Breaking: the `index` command is removed. Run `review` to get refs.
- Breaking: `hunkRefs` accept strings only. A path covers every live hunk of that file, `path@oldStart+newStart` names one hunk, and `old -> new@oldStart+newStart` names a rename. The object form no longer validates.
- Document `parts[]` holds a one-sentence summary per story. Validate requires every group `part` to have an entry.

UI
- Overview shows each story summary under its colored part header.
- The diff shows git renames, copies, and moved lines. A pure move or copy shows the paths and the similarity score, with no delete and add blocks.
- The header, groups, and file list show how many files are left to read in this session. Viewed marks stay in session storage for the base and head commits, not in the review file.

Skill
- Writes review.json from the `review` skeleton instead of hand-pasted index refs.
- Batches the ref checks, version check, review, log, and stat into one shell call, and inlines the field shape so the normal path skips example.md and the schema.
- Excludes only the lockfiles that appear in the covering stat.
- Names a commit source by its git subject or SHA.
- Accepts a local executable in place of npx and checks its --version.
- Pins npx comprehende@0.9.0.
